body: AUDIT-7 Lane 4 suspect-closure pointer: #6378 / PR #8032. PR #8032 adopted `cargo-nextest` for `pkgs/id` recipes and shards. The original issue still lists targets for unit (<2 min), integration (<5 min), E2E (<10 min), NixOS VM optimization and CI optimization. Its own triage note #6737334164 narrowed #8032 to nextest adoption and left VM optimization and selective-by-path execution as later slices; the recorded 3468-test `--all-features --lib` run took 132s and did not measure integration/E2E/VM legs. #6378 closed with #8032 before those remainders were separately tracked. Follow-up issue #15079 is now open with live remote-measurement task #23801. Lane 2 owns the closure review; no reopen was made.
